explanation: The lemma is a definitional unfolding (proved by `rfl`) of the library's own definition `CompHausAddCommGrp.FiniteBar.chainsMap` (ContinuousGroupCohomology/CompactBarFunctoriality.lean:45), which is built from the library-local `CompHausAddCommGrp.finiteFinsuppMap` (CompactFiniteHomology.lean:64) on the library's own category `CompHausAddCommGrp` — that category, `chains`, `finiteFinsuppMap` and `FiniteBar.chainsMap` do not exist in Mathlib (grep for `CompHausAddCommGrp`, `finiteFinsuppMap`, `FiniteBar` in Mathlib/Batteries/Lean core gives nothing). The only Mathlib gadget with a similar name is the algebraic `groupHomology.chainsMap` (Mathlib/RepresentationTheory/Homological/GroupHomology/Functoriality.lean:58) on `inhomogeneousChains` over `ModuleCat`, whose pointwise computation lemmas are the `@[simps]`-generated `chainsMap_f` and `chainsMap_f_single`; those are stated for a different object (no topology, no compact Hausdorff additive group) and say nothing about the library's continuous `chainsMap`. Hence no Mathlib declaration states this result, even as a special case.
